messages:
maria_marketing: Need a compact bench pack for tomorrows webinar + press appendix. Minimal requirements: 1) 20 sanitized payloads (short/med/long/edge), 2) single-copy command for hosted + dedicated, 3) p50/p95/p99 cold vs warmed, 4) quantized (q4) vs FP deltas, 5) provenance line. Can you get it to us by EOD today? @ken_runtime @zoe_eng :pray:

ken_runtime: Can do. Quick clarifying q's: which model tag for the slide numbers? redwood-v2-7b:stable or redwood-v2-7b:2026-03? Also streaming vs non-streaming metrics?

maria_marketing: Use redwood-v2-7b:stable. Metrics non-streaming (token timing). We'll still demo with streaming but slides list non-stream numbers.

zoe_eng: For repeatability we'll run 3 fresh process trials and give raw per-request latencies. Will label payloads as synthetic or sanitized.

eli_metrics: I'll compute bootstrap CIs across the three trials for p95/p99. Please include per-request CSV with no prompt text.

ken_runtime: Plan: create bench_2109876543/{payloads.json,manifest.csv,run_hosted.sh,run_dedicated.sh,report.csv,README.md}. Example host command we'll include:

```bash
REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./run_hosted.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:stable --quant q4 --payloads payloads.json --seq 512 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --repeats 3 --out out/2109876543
```

ken_runtime: Dedicated command snippet also included with docker image and exact commit sha. We'll add a one-line copyable provenance entry as requested.

maria_marketing: Please make the headline one-liner precise for PR: e.g. "q4 quantized p95 latency +8% vs FP; throughput +30%"  but only if measured numbers match. Legal needs exact measured value in the README.

ken_runtime: Understood. We'll put the exact measured sentence in README.md and mark the CI bounds. If numbers don't support the phrasing we'll provide the exact percent and a suggested wording.

zoe_eng: Note: one long payload had verbatim third-party text; we sanitized it and flagged in manifest. If marketing prefers different synthetic style, tell us quickly.

artifact-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/mini/2109876543/bench-pack.tar.gz (payloads.json, manifest.csv, run_hosted.sh, run_dedicated.sh, report.csv, README.md)

maria_marketing: Thanks all. We'll review the README and report first thing and ask for a re-run only if numbers look inconsistent. :thumbsup:

eli_metrics: If you ask for a re-run, include the exact artifact_id and we'll re-run with identical seed and capture traces.

maria_marketing: Noted. Appreciate the fast turnaround! :rocket:
